Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mg and Mn centers each in octahedral environments of six O neighbors, while Na centers are six-coordinate with oxygen. These polyhedra connect into a three-dimensional network, with Mn–Mg octahedra and Mn–Na six-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
